_comment: Announcements shown at the top of the FLEX 7-1 page.
Each entry needs 'text'. Everything else is optional:
title   a bold heading above the text
until   YYYY-MM-DD, the last day it shows; it disappears by itself after that
pinned  true to keep it at the top of the list
Leave the list empty and the whole section disappears.
This file is never touched by the daily refresh, so edits here stick.

announcements.title: Mass of the Holy Spirit is Monday
announcements.text: We go straight to Our Lady of Belen Chapel at 1:15 instead of meeting in our room. Special Dress Uniform - shirt tucked in, tie on, blazer.
